item.title: How EVE Frontier’s game director is thinking about AI agents
item.summary: Player empowerment sits at the heart of EVE Frontier. Indeed, this is exactly the frame its game director FC Goodfella uses to explain how the studio is approaching making a blockchain game for a world of abundant artificial intelligence.
